## E-two — Competitive teardown

No competitor product covering Hawaii how bad driving habits form from laziness, impatience, inattention, arrogance and ignorance, distracted driving, the five rules of defensive driving, attentiveness and scanning, driver and vehicle condition, trip planning, warning lamps, safety belts, what happens in a collision and protecting a baby in the car was reviewed, so this teardown names no rival, quotes no price, compares no structure and records no praise or complaint.

The adopt-and-beat analysis of the master template is explicitly out of scope for this handbook-section dossier; a future market pass with its own sources would own it.

Pedagogy, practice-item and coverage comparison tables are therefore absent by explicit scope choice, not by omission.

Disposition: teardown for this section is present as an explicit scoped statement, not as researched competitive evidence.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the how bad driving habits form from laziness, impatience, inattention, arrogance and ignorance, distracted driving, the five rules of defensive driving, attentiveness and scanning, driver and vehicle condition, trip planning, warning lamps, safety belts, what happens in a collision and protecting a baby in the car rules on pages 57–63 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
